note: A 5-fold ENERGY / archetype layer over the 78 cards — the emblem each card carries, reflecting the KIND of energy (not good/bad, not the card's strength). Use it as a SPREAD-LEVEL signal (dominant energy) alongside dominant_suit and Major-Arcana weight. Keyed by card number 00-77.
design: On the physical/art deck the emblem is a small enamel seal (~8-12mm) set into the lower-left medallion of the frame — a hidden layer the viewer notices after the art and title, not a big label.

Blessing.spread_meaning: a season of growth and success — the current supports building and acting

Balance.spread_meaning: harmony and a choice to weigh — steady, cooperative, deliberate

Trial.spread_meaning: a testing period — risk and pressure; endure, verify, protect

Transformation.spread_meaning: change and learning — an evolution, a new stage, letting the old go

Karma.spread_meaning: forces of fate and cycles beyond full control — align with the current, don't force it
